target.title: fix(telegram): dedupe directive-tag prompt context
target.body:
﻿## Summary

Fixes #99117.

Telegram direct-message prompt context currently dedupes session transcript rows against Telegram cache rows using `timestamp_ms` plus exact body text. When the transcript copy still contains inline directive tags such as `[[reply_to_current]]` but the Telegram cache copy contains the delivered text, both rows survive and the model sees the same assistant reply twice.

This PR moves the dedupe and session/cache merge logic into a small Telegram-owned module and normalizes bodies with the existing public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-chunking` delivery stripping helper before constructing the timestamp/body key. That matches the text shape Telegram delivery records in cache, including inline tags such as `hello [[reply_to_current]] world` becoming `hello world`. The timestamp remains part of the key, preserving the timestamp-alignment behavior from #98769 while making directive-tag variants compare as the same delivered reply.

## Verification

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- Red check: `pnpm exec tsx -e "import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.js').catch((err)=>{ console.error(err.message); process.exit(1); })"` failed before implementation with missing module.
- Red check for the quality uplift: `pnpm exec tsx -e "import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts').then((m)=>{ if(typeof m.mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages !== 'function') throw new Error('merge helper missing'); })"` failed before the merge helper existed.
- `pnpm exec tsx -e "import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts').then(({resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey,mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages})=>{ const a=resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'[[reply_to_current]]Yep - I\'m here now.'}); const b=resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'Yep - I\'m here now.'}); const c=resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms:1778474761000,body:'Yep - I\'m here now.'}); if(a!==b) throw new Error('directive-stripped keys did not match'); if(a===c) throw new Error('timestamp alignment was lost'); const merged=mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages({sessionPromptMessages:[{message_id:'session:a1',timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'[[reply_to_current]]Yep - I\'m here now.'}],cachePromptMessages:[{message_id:'736',timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'Yep - I\'m here now.'}]}); if(merged.sessionOnlyPromptMessages.length!==0) throw new Error('session row was not filtered'); if(merged.promptMessages.length!==1 || merged.promptMessages[0].message_id!=='736') throw new Error('cache row was not retained'); const drift=mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages({sessionPromptMessages:[{message_id:'session:a1',timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'[[reply_to_current]]Yep - I\'m here now.'}],cachePromptMessages:[{message_id:'736',timestamp_ms:1778474761000,body:'Yep - I\'m here now.'}]}); if(drift.promptMessages.length!==2) throw new Error('timestamp drift rows collapsed'); console.log('prompt-context key and merge assertions passed'); })"`
- `pnpm exec tsx -e "import { mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages, resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey } from './extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts'; const same = resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms: 1, body: 'hello [[reply_to_current]] world'}) === resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms: 1, body: 'hello world'}); if (!same) throw new Error('inline directive key mismatch'); const merged = mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages({ sessionPromptMessages: [{message_id: 'session:inline', timestamp_ms: 1, body: 'hello [[reply_to_current]] world'}], cachePromptMessages: [{message_id: '736', timestamp_ms: 1, body: 'hello world'}] }); if (merged.sessionOnlyPromptMessages.length !== 0 || merged.promptMessages.length !== 1 || merged.promptMessages[0]?.message_id !== '736') throw new Error('inline directive merge mismatch'); console.log('telegram prompt-context inline directive dedupe passed');"`
- `pnpm exec tsx -e "Promise.all([import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts'), import('./extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts')]).then(([m])=>{ const merged=m.mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages({sessionPromptMessages:[{message_id:'session:a1',timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'[[reply_to_current]]Yep'}],cachePromptMessages:[{message_id:'736',timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'Yep'}]}); if(merged.promptMessages.length!==1 || merged.promptMessages[0].message_id!=='736') throw new Error('merge proof failed'); console.log('telegram prompt-context imports and merge resolved'); })"`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts`
- `node scripts/check-extension-plugin-sdk-boundary.mjs --mode=src-outside-plugin-sdk`
- `git diff --check`

Known local proof gaps:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts`, `pnpm test extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts -- --run`, and raw `pnpm exec vitest run extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts` did not reach test output in this Windows worktree before being stopped; raw Vitest repeatedly stayed in workspace compile/plugin timing output.
- `pnpm exec tsgo -p extensions/telegram/tsconfig.json --noEmit` is not a valid local narrow check in this worktree as-is; it fails on many existing `openclaw/plugin-sdk/*` type-resolution errors unrelated to this diff.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` failed before review with Windows `NotADirectoryError: [WinError 267]` while spawning `git`, including through a temporary `subst` ASCII drive.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Telegram DM prompt context no longer keeps both the synthetic session transcript assistant row and the Telegram cache assistant row when the only body difference is inline directive tags stripped for delivery.

Real environment tested: Local Windows source worktree, focused helper/runtime import proof, and PR `Real behavior proof` check.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: See `Verification` above.

Evidence after fix: The focused helper assertions showed `[[reply_to_current]]Yep - I'm here now.` and `Yep - I'm here now.` produce the same dedupe key at the same timestamp; `hello [[reply_to_current]] world` and `hello world` also produce the same key after delivery-style normalization; the merge assertions showed the synthetic session row is filtered while the Telegram cache row is retained; the timestamp-drift assertion showed different timestamps still keep both rows.

Observed result after fix: `prompt-context key and merge assertions passed`; `telegram prompt-context inline directive dedupe passed`; `telegram prompt-context imports and merge resolved`.

What was not tested: No completed live Telegram DM artifact is attached yet. The PR still needs Mantis or equivalent redacted Telegram proof to clear the scoped Telegram reply-context proof bar.
